notes: WI-09 (UC-010) — POST /geo/route (verb+contract change) + GET /geo/config + allowlist update. == WHAT WAS DELIVERED == 1. POST /geo/route (replaces GET /geo/route): - RouteRequest now has GeoPoint? From and GeoPoint? To instead of 4 string? query params. - GeoPoint is a plain class with double Lat, double Lng — NO required keyword (STJ body binding is invariant-culture, so string workaround is NOT needed for POST body; required would cause STJ JsonException → 500 via DontCatchExceptions). - RouteResponse now includes IReadOnlyList? Geometry (geometry converted from MapyGeoPoint[] to double[][] pairs). - RouteValidator validates From/To NotNull + WGS84 range (-90..90 / -180..180) + null-island (0,0) rejection using existing ErrorCodes.Validation.PickupCoordsOutOfRange / DropoffCoordsOutOfRange. - X-Geo-Source: mapy and X-Geo-Cache: hit|miss headers set before Send.OkAsync. - Upstream Unavailable (IsEstimate=true) → 502 + Geo.RouteUnavailable (maintained from WI-07). 2. GET /geo/config (NEW — anonymous, mirrors GetFleetEndpoint pattern): - EndpointWithoutRequest, AllowAnonymous(), DontCatchExceptions(). - Fleet resolved via TenantResolutionMiddleware from X-Fleet-Slug header (same as /public/fleet). - Returns TileUrlTemplate + BrowserKey (decrypted via IFleetKeyProtector) + AttributionHtml + MapCenterLat/Lng + MapZoom. - BrowserKey fallback: fleet MapyBrowserKey → env Mapy:BrowserKey → empty string. - Tile URL and attribution HTML are constants in Common/Geo/MapyConstants.cs (Mapy.com raster tile URL with {z}/{x}/{y}/{apikey} placeholders + mandatory attribution). - Cache-Control: public, max-age=604800 set via HttpContext.Response.Headers before Send.OkAsync. - AC#7 structural security: GeoConfigResponse record has NO server-key property — the MapyServerKey column is structurally impossible to appear in the response. 3. Updated existing tests to use POST instead of GET: - GeoProxyTests.cs: 4 route tests updated. - RouteAccessTests.cs: 3 tests updated. - SuggestAccessTests.cs: 1 test updated. 4. OpenAPI allowlist in SeedAndEndToEndTests.cs: changed 'GET /api/v1/geo/route' → 'POST /api/v1/geo/route'; added 'GET /api/v1/geo/config'. 5. docs/api.md regenerated by OpenApi_Document_GeneratesApiMarkdown test. == TESTS ADDED == GeoRouteTests.cs (4 new): - HandleAsync_PostRouteValidBody_ReturnsDistanceDurationGeometry - HandleAsync_RouteBodyZeroZero_Returns400 - HandleAsync_RouteMissingFrom_Returns400 - HandleAsync_RouteUpstreamUnavailable_Returns502 GeoConfigTests.cs (4 new): - HandleAsync_GeoConfigAnonymous_ReturnsBrowserKeyNotServerKey - GeoConfig_And_PublicFleet_NeverExposeServerKey - HandleAsync_GeoConfigNoSlug_Returns404 - HandleAsync_GeoConfig_SetsCacheControlHeader == DESIGN DECISIONS == - Geometry: converted from IReadOnlyList to List in RouteEndpoint. Empty geometry (FakeGeoService default []) returns null in the response. - GeoConfigEndpoint gracefully handles missing FleetSettings row: returns defaults + empty/env browser key. - Tile URL: 'https://api.mapy.cz/v1/maptiles/basic/256/{z}/{x}/{y}?apikey={apikey}'. Clients replace {apikey} with BrowserKey. - Attribution HTML: '© Seznam.cz, a.s. a další' — mandatory per Mapy.com terms. == CONTRACT BREAK FOR WI-15/16 == The web client (client.ts) and frontend callers of GET /geo/route MUST be updated to POST /geo/route with JSON body { from: { lat, lng }, to: { lat, lng } }. Deferred to WI-15/16 per instructions. == WARNING — TILE URL AND ATTRIBUTION NOT AUTHORITATIVE == TileUrlTemplate ('https://api.mapy.cz/v1/maptiles/basic/256/{z}/{x}/{y}?apikey={apikey}') and AttributionHtml are best-effort from general Mapy.com knowledge — the repo's spec/decisions/MapyClient files contain no tile URL, and there is no web access to Mapy's live docs. WI-15/16 MUST verify: (1) the exact tile path (/v1/maptiles/basic/256/ vs another variant), (2) the {apikey} query-param substitution contract, (3) the @2x tile variant URL (for devicePixelRatio > 1.5), and (4) the exact mandatory attribution text/link against the live Mapy.com API docs before relying on MapyConstants.cs values. The API tests only assert Contains('mapy.cz') and NotBeNullOrEmpty(), so they would pass with a wrong URL.
